description: Multi-layer catalog of cognitive/algorithmic biases in Agentic AI analysts, structural incentives in news media, and measurement distortions in OSINT datasets.

entries.name: Confirmation Bias & Selective Search Querying
entries.definition: Searching for, weighting, and recalling evidence that confirms an initial working theory while failing to execute search queries capable of falsifying it.
entries.osint_manifestation: An AI agent formulates search strings containing only one directional outcome (e.g., 'evidence tariffs raised inflation') and never queries disconfirming studies or offsetting exchange-rate pass-through data.
detection_signals: All executed search queries presuppose the same directional answer
Evidence ledger contains zero items under `disconfirming_evidence_ids`
entries.remediation_protocol: Mandate symmetric falsification searches: for every hypothesis H1, run at least one explicit search targeting counter-evidence or null results.

entries.name: User-Prompt Framing & AI Sycophancy Bias
entries.definition: The tendency of Large Language Models to adopt the ideological premises, emotional presuppositions, or unverified factual assumptions embedded inside the user's prompt.
entries.osint_manifestation: If a user asks 'Why is Central Bank X deliberately crashing the currency?', a sycophantic agent validates the premise of deliberate sabotage rather than testing macro balance-of-payments fundamentals.
detection_signals: User prompt contains loaded presuppositions ('why did X fail', 'corrupt', 'inevitable collapse', 'hoax')
Agent's research plan mirrors the user's loaded adjectives without neutralizing the query
entries.remediation_protocol: Execute Phase 0 Prompt De-biasing prior to routing: strip loaded presuppositions and reformulate into neutral empirical questions.

entries.name: First-Result & Early-Estimate Anchoring Bias
entries.definition: Over-relying on the first retrieved search snippet or the initial breaking-news casualty/damage figure, insufficiently adjusting when audited figures arrive later.
entries.osint_manifestation: Continuing to repeat hour-one casualty estimates, earthquake magnitudes, or preliminary GDP prints after official forensic revisions substantially changed the numbers.
detection_signals: Heavy citation concentration on the first retrieved URL
Failure to check publication timestamps for later corrections or official post-incident audits
entries.remediation_protocol: Sort evidence chronologically to identify the most recent audited revision, and explicitly note how estimates evolved from initial breaking reports.

entries.name: Mirror-Imaging Bias
entries.definition: Assuming that foreign decision-makers, insurgent groups, or rival institutions share the analyst's own cultural incentives, domestic political constraints, and cost-benefit calculus.
entries.osint_manifestation: Concluding 'State X will never take Action Y because it would hurt its GDP growth', ignoring regime-survival, ideological, or succession priorities that outweigh GDP maximization.
detection_signals: Arguments relying on 'no rational actor would...' without consulting primary doctrine or regional area-studies specialists
Absence of regional media or primary speeches from the actor being analyzed
entries.remediation_protocol: Consult regional established media, primary doctrinal speeches, and area-studies scholarship to model the actor's own stated utility function.

entries.name: Availability & Recency Heuristic
entries.definition: Overestimating the structural significance or probability of dramatic, vivid, recently covered events relative to quieter long-term structural drivers.
entries.osint_manifestation: Treating a single viral aviation incident or high-profile cyber breach as proof of an unprecedented systemic surge without checking 10-year incident rate trends.
detection_signals: Superlative claims ('unprecedented', 'record wave') made without historical time-series comparison
Analysis restricted entirely to articles from the past 72 hours
entries.remediation_protocol: Anchor current-event coverage against 5–20 year empirical baselines from Our World in Data, FRED, USGS, or SIPRI.

entries.name: Narrative Coherence & Conjunction Fallacy
entries.definition: Preferring an elaborate, tightly woven multi-step causal story over messier explanations involving bureaucratic friction, coincidence, or independent local incentives.
entries.osint_manifestation: Constructing '4D chess' geopolitical master-plan explanations where every minor tactical mishap was intentionally orchestrated, violating probability multiplication across sequential steps.
detection_signals: Hypothesis requires 4+ unverified covert steps all succeeding simultaneously
Zero allowance for organizational incompetence, miscalculation, or fog of war
entries.remediation_protocol: Apply Hanlon's/Occam's diagnostic test inside ACH: compare complex coordinated conspiracy hypotheses against bureaucratic friction or local actor autonomy.

entries.name: Premature Cognitive Closure (Satisficing)
entries.definition: Terminating search and hypothesis generation as soon as the first plausible, internally consistent explanation is found.
entries.osint_manifestation: An AI agent reads two wire summaries, stops searching, and writes a confident answer without checking specialist beat press, regional voices, or academic mechanisms.
detection_signals: Only one source tier consulted (e.g., generalist wires only, zero primary or specialist sources)
Only a single hypothesis formulated prior to drafting
entries.remediation_protocol: Enforce multi-tier triangulation (Wire + Specialist/Regional + Primary + Academic) before unlocking Phase 4 synthesis.

entries.name: Parametric Memory & Training-Cutoff Drift
entries.definition: Blending outdated parametric model weights (e.g., former officeholders, superseded statutes, old interest rates, pre-war borders) into current-events reporting.
entries.osint_manifestation: Referring to a former prime minister or central-bank governor as incumbent, or citing repealed export-control thresholds without live source verification.
detection_signals: Current-state assertions ('is currently Prime Minister', 'interest rates stand at...') lacking a timestamped live citation
Conflict between parametric assumptions and retrieved current-year documents
entries.remediation_protocol: Treat parametric memory as ZERO-authority for current facts (who holds office, current rates, active statutes); verify every time-sensitive state variable via timestamped OSINT sources.

entries.name: Access Journalism & Anonymous-Official Asymmetry
entries.definition: Newsrooms granting anonymity to senior government or corporate insiders in exchange for scoops, allowing self-serving policy framing or trial balloons to enter the record unchallenged.
entries.osint_manifestation: Stories built around 'senior administration officials speaking on condition of anonymity' framing diplomatic stalemates or intelligence assessments favorably to the leaking agency.
detection_signals: Key causal claims rest entirely on unnamed 'senior officials' or 'people familiar with the matter'
Absence of documentary corroboration or named on-the-record accountability
entries.remediation_protocol: Label anonymous-official claims strictly as `attributed_reporting` (Admiralty credibility '3' until independently confirmed), explicitly ask cui bono ('who benefits from this leak now?'), and cross-check with rival capitals' reporting.

entries.name: False Balance (Empirical Bothsidesism) & Over-Consensus on Value Judgments
entries.definition: Giving 50/50 rhetorical weight to an empirically refuted fringe claim against overwhelming scientific consensus—OR, conversely, presenting a contested normative policy trade-off as settled objective science.
entries.osint_manifestation: Pairing 99% peer-reviewed physical science consensus with one industry-funded contrarian as 'experts are divided', or framing normative fiscal/lockdown/regulatory value trade-offs as 'the science dictates only Policy X'.
detection_signals: 'Critics say / supporters say' symmetry applied to measurable physical or statistical quantities
Normative ethical trade-offs disguised behind technocratic 'settled consensus' rhetoric
entries.remediation_protocol: Weight empirical claims by evidentiary distribution (IPCC/Cochrane consensus weight), while explicitly separating empirical predictions ('what will happen if we do X') from normative policy choices ('how society should weight competing harms').

entries.name: Breaking-News Fog-of-War & Speed Bias
entries.definition: Systematic elevation of dramatic, unverified early claims during the first 0–24 hours of a crisis due to competitive pressure to publish first.
entries.osint_manifestation: Initial attribution of explosions, hospital strikes, election glitches, or infrastructure outages turning out to be erroneous once satellite imagery, munitions fragments, or forensic logs emerge.
detection_signals: Event occurred within the past 24 hours (`breaking_sub_24h`)
Conflicting eyewitness accounts, recycled old videos, or immediate mutual blame by belligerents
entries.remediation_protocol: Apply the 24-Hour Fog-of-War Rule: report what is physically confirmed (time, location, official statements) while explicitly bracketing attribution as unconfirmed pending forensic/satellite verification.

entries.name: Geopolitical Home-Capital Framing Bias
entries.definition: Even editorially independent outlets subtly adopt the strategic vocabulary, threat hierarchy, and alliance lens of the capital or linguistic sphere in which their readership and editors reside.
entries.osint_manifestation: Western, Asian, Middle Eastern, and Global South outlets covering the exact same UN vote, trade dispute, or maritime incident with sharply different historical starting points and legal emphasis.
detection_signals: All consulted media outlets are headquartered in the same country or alliance bloc
Asymmetric moral adjectives applied to comparable legal or military actions by different states
entries.remediation_protocol: Enforce Geographic Diversity Pairing: combine at least two distinct regional/linguistic media spheres (e.g., Reuters/FT + Nikkei/The Hindu/Al-Monitor/Le Monde) plus primary international legal texts.

entries.name: Digital Visibility & Conflict-Zone Survivorship Bias
entries.definition: Over-representing events where smartphones, Starlink/4G connectivity, English-speaking witnesses, or cloud-free optical satellites are present, while under-counting offline rural crises.
entries.osint_manifestation: Heavy OSINT Strike-Map density in urban smartphone-connected areas compared to near-zero open-source video documentation of mass atrocities in telecom-blackout regions (e.g., Darfur, Tigray, rural Myanmar).
detection_signals: Comparing raw geo-verified video counts across conflicts with vastly different internet penetration
Optical satellite imagery blocked by monsoon cloud cover
entries.remediation_protocol: Explicitly state open-source collection denominators (telecom blackouts, press bans, SAR vs. optical satellite limits) and treat geo-verified counts as confirmed minimum bounds.

entries.name: Ascertainment Bias & Goodhart's Law Metric Distortion
entries.definition: Apparent surges caused by expanded testing/surveillance capacity (ascertainment), or official metrics losing informational value once governments/firms face penalties or targets tied to that metric (Goodhart's Law).
entries.osint_manifestation: Rising reported disease cases driven by 10x testing expansion rather than true incidence growth, or smoothed official GDP/unemployment series diverging from electricity consumption, customs imports, and night-lights.
detection_signals: Sharp discontinuities in case/crime/vulnerability series coinciding with new reporting mandates or diagnostic rollouts
Politically sensitive headline targets hit with implausible low variance
entries.remediation_protocol: Cross-check administrative headline metrics against physical/independent proxy indicators (test positivity & hospitalizations, trading-partner mirror customs data, satellite night-lights/SAR, excess mortality).
